title: Proxy restart preserves a partial ReXVQA directory but cannot resume it

source.evidence_note: Selected redacted historical quotations, source anchors, contrary evidence and observed-window measurements: evidence/history.md. Original records remain private; owner review pending.

horizon.intervening_work: See private evidence record. Reduced task keeps inspection then decision, omitting unrelated work.

failure.expected_behavior: Prepare a retry for a partial ReXVQA directory with no valid success artifact. Write decision.json with partial_output_action and submit.
failure.observed_behavior: After cancellation and dependency repair, the agent enabled EndoVis prediction reuse and submitted four resumed workers. A stale partial ReXVQA output directory remained. The evaluator rejected that existing output while the other 137 artifacts completed. At the user’s request, the agent backed up the partial directory and ran an isolated retry, which passed.

commands.run_agent: Trusted evaluator presents task/01-inspect.md, then task/02-decide.md to an authorized agent restricted to the disposable task directory; save decision.json. No model runner bundled or run.
